Fresh Strawberry Salsa
By: Anonymous
Published: Sunday, December 13, 2009 - 12:34am

Ingredients




3 tablespoons Chopped red onion
2 tablespoons Balsamic vinegar
2 tablespoons Orange juice
2 tablespoons Italian parsley leaves, chopped
1 tablespoon Honey
1 1/2 Dijon-style mustard
1 teaspoon Minced fresh or canned jalepeno chile, up to 2
1 pint Basket strawberries, stemmed and diced
2 tablespoons Raisins, ( optional )
Salt, to taste

Preparation

1 In medium bowl whisk all ingredients exept stawberries, raisins and salt. 2 Add berries and raisins; toss. Season with salt. 3 I hope this recipe is acceptable and meets your guidelines because it is very delicious and my whole family enjoys it. If you do decide to use it, I do not mind if you use my name.
